evidence.quoted_text:
explicit_timeout = _section_values(
            service_text, "Service", "TimeoutStartSec")
        if explicit_timeout:
            service_timeout = _duration_seconds(_single_value(
                explicit_timeout, "service TimeoutStartSec"))
evidence.reason: The adapter reads only TimeoutStartSec and otherwise falls back to 90 seconds for simple services, so it does not account for systemd's TimeoutSec= directive. systemd applies TimeoutSec to the start timeout as well, and when TimeoutSec appears after TimeoutStartSec in the file, the later TimeoutSec value is the effective start timeout. A template with TimeoutStartSec=30s followed by TimeoutSec=5min would therefore be recorded as 90 seconds by this code instead of 300 seconds, causing the start operation to time out before systemd would. This is an implementation error in reconciling the target template, not a new requirement. A template with only TimeoutStartSec can retain current behavior.
